findings.title: Failed posts leave PR proofs missing
findings.description: `publish()` saves `s.posted` as the full proof count before the description PATCH or any proof comment succeeds. If either GitHub operation fails, a later owner retry reaches the count-based return and never publishes the missing material.

findings.title: Old runs repost published proof comments
findings.description: `publish()` treats a missing `s.posted` field as zero and selects every proof after the first as a new comment. Runs saved by the previous runner have no such field, so resuming one with existing proof comments posts those comments again.

findings.title: Removed PR proofs are not restored
findings.description: `publish()` returns on the saved count without checking whether the PR still contains the proofs it represents. If a proof is removed from the description or its comment is deleted while the run continues, later publication steps leave that proof absent.
